acceptance.finalReview: Approve only when the seeded regression, rollback rehearsal, and compatibility constraint are evidenced; this fixture does not establish broader family coverage.

steps: add a failing regression for the seeded defect

riskAssessment.blastRadius: An unreviewed image could be promoted despite passing component tests
constraints: Do not rebuild or resign artifacts during final review
riskAssessment.distractorDisposition: Exclude Changelog punctuation; it is unrelated to the seeded defect.
riskAssessment.seededDefect: release manifest references an image digest not produced by the locked build

actions: Reject the candidate, revoke its approval record, and retain evidence for audit
rollback.compatibility: Do not rebuild or resign artifacts during final review
rollback.trigger: Rollback if `./scripts/verify-candidate.sh release/candidate.json` fails or the stated blast-radius symptom appears.

summary: Narrow Release candidate provenance review to the seeded final-review-security defect and its compatibility boundary.
